pages.text: A serpon wizard steeped in fire magic, the caster of the legion, hovering above the field to fling fireballs and cones of flame.

You can summon this flame mage by ritual, or seek his help for a while with a $(l:supreme/items/serpon_flame_focus)Serpon Flame Focus$().$(br)You can right-click your Serpon Flame Wizard with $(item)Blaze Powder$() or a $(item)Blaze Rod$() to heal it.
